title: 4D-STEM in SEM With 1 Million Frames Per Second: Enabling Ptychography and Advanced 4D-STEM Processing
content: In recent years, the field of imaging in transmission electron microscopes (TEMs) has seen a rapid improvement in resolution, allowing visualization with unprecedented clarity. This “Resolution Revolution” was brought about by several advancements in instrumentation, such as aberration correction, energy filtering, and detector improvements. In particular, direct electron detectors provided a leap forward in terms of sensitivity, radiation hardness, noiseless imaging and high frame rates.
